guide.title: How to Use Job Listings
guide.description: On this page, you can search for and apply to open job listings from your teams. Follow the steps below to find a job.

team.title: Select a Team to Browse Jobs
team.body: Jobs on Mannschaft are posted through teams you belong to. Start by selecting a team from the selector at the top of the page.
team.step1: Click the "Select a Team" selector at the top of the page
team.step2: Choose one of your teams from the list
team.step3: Open job listings for that team will be displayed

card.title: Reading a Job Card
card.body: Each job card shows the key information about a position at a glance.
card.item_status: Badge (top right) — shows current status such as "Open"
card.item_pay: Pay amount and type (lump sum / hourly / daily)
card.item_schedule: Work date/time, location, headcount, and application deadline

detail.title: View Job Details
detail.body: Click a card to open the detail page, where you can see the full job description, location, pay, and deadline.
detail.step1: Click on a job card you're interested in
detail.step2: Review the full job description, conditions, and pay
detail.step3: Click "Apply" when you're ready to apply

apply.title: Apply for a Job
apply.body: Click "Apply" and enter a cover message (up to 500 characters). This is the first thing the hiring manager will see, so write carefully.
apply.step1: Click the "Apply" button on the job detail page
apply.step2: Enter your cover message in the dialog (up to 500 characters — optional)
apply.step4: After applying, check your application status on "My Jobs"

pagination.title: Browse More Listings
pagination.body: If there are more than 20 listings, a pagination control will appear at the bottom.
pagination.step1: Click a page number or the ">" button at the bottom
pagination.step2: The next 20 listings will be displayed
